My teaching has ranged from first-year mathematics and physics to advanced topics in gravitation, quantum mechanics and quantum field theory.

## Universitat de Barcelona

Recent teaching includes:

- **Calculus I** — BSc in Biomedical Engineering
- **General Relativity** — BSc in Physics
- **Electrodynamics** — BSc in Physics
- **Quantum Mechanics** — BSc in Physics

Across the 2022–2026 academic years I have repeatedly taught Calculus I and General Relativity at UB, alongside additional teaching in Electrodynamics, Quantum Mechanics and laboratory physics.

## Other teaching

- **Geometría del espaciotiempo. Agujeros negros y ondas gravitacionales**, UNED open teaching programme (2026)
- **Quantum Mechanics**, KU Leuven (2016–2018)
- **Advanced Field Theory**, KU Leuven (2015–2016)

- **Explorations in String Theory / Holography**, Perimeter Scholars International (2014)

## Schools and advanced lectures

I have given school lectures on entanglement in quantum field theory, General Relativity and higher-curvature gravity, including lectures at ICTP, Instituto Balseiro and international schools in Europe and Latin America.
